issues.description: Resolver no longer marks requirements as prepared, silently shifting that responsibility to every caller
issues.detail: The resolver used to set req.prepared = True and req.needs_more_preparation = False after the more-prep step. Removing it without giving callers a single place to do the same complects 'resolved' with 'prepared' across three command files. Each command must now remember to call prepare_linked_requirements_more in the right place and order. That is place-oriented state spread across files instead of one explicit transition.

issues.description: InstallRequirement now has three overlapping sources of distribution truth
issues.detail: get_dist() now branches over _distribution, metadata_directory, and local_file_path. These are three identities for what is conceptually one value: 'the distribution this requirement represents at time T.' Whichever was set last wins, with no invariant stating why. This is COMPLECTED state where one explicit field (or a discriminated value) would make the time semantics clear.

issues.description: download_info side-effect buried inside _fetch_metadata_only path leaks dry-run policy into the preparer
issues.detail: Setting req.download_info = direct_url_from_link(...) inside prepare_linked_requirement is the preparer deciding what 'dry-run mode' means for downstream commands like pip lock and --report. That policy belongs to the caller, not the metadata fetch branch. This complects metadata fetching, download tracking, and reporting contracts in one if-block.

issues.description: set_dist/get_dist accessor pair re-introduces place-oriented mutation where a value would do
issues.detail: The new _distribution field plus setter/getter is a mutable slot on a long-lived object, used to communicate between two phases of the same pipeline. A return value from _fetch_metadata_only threaded through the caller would express the same fact without an extra identity. The accessor pair is EASY-NOT-SIMPLE: familiar OO shape, not actually decomposed.

issues.description: prepare_linked_requirements_more call is duplicated verbatim across download, install, and wheel commands
issues.detail: Three commands now contain the same one-liner in the same logical position. That is incidental duplication arising because the resolver stopped doing the step and no single seam took it over. A small explicit 'finalize(requirement_set)' function, or having the resolver expose an explicit two-phase API, would name the transition once.

issues.description: No test or assertion encodes the new invariant that dry-run must not download wheels
issues.detail: The whole point of the change is a behavioral guarantee: under --dry-run with PEP-658 metadata, no full wheel is fetched. That guarantee currently lives only in the absence of a call site. A test that asserts the network/file fetch did not happen would pin the property; without it, any future caller re-adding prepare_linked_requirements_more silently regresses #12603.

review.summary: The change correctly identifies that 'resolve' and 'fully prepare' were complected in the resolver and pulls them apart — that direction is right. But the decomposition stops halfway. The resolver no longer finalizes prepared/needs_more_preparation state, yet no single seam takes that role, so three commands each carry the same one-liner and the invariant lives in their collective memory. Inside InstallRequirement, a new _distribution slot plus set_dist/get_dist adds a third source of truth for 'the distribution', and a download_info side-effect inside the metadata-fetch branch quietly encodes dry-run policy in the preparer. The fix is closer to simple than what was there, but it is still place-oriented; a small explicit finalize step and a single discriminated distribution value would make the time semantics honest.
